verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API covers many core objects (campaigns, events, profiles, webhooks) and offers SDKs, OAuth, and an MCP server for AI agent access, showing broad programmatic coverage, but the evidence never claims full UI/API parity — no mention of API access to drag-and-drop editor design, Composer AI workflows, or other UI-exclusive tools. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API endpoints for visual email/SMS template building, API exposure of AI features like Composer/Customer Agent.
